backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor for the CivWorld backend defining all data types (UserProfile, Post, Comment, Poll, Group, Notification, etc.) and including mixins for blob storage and authorization. Serves as the central canister integrating migration, access control, and all social/civic platform features.
backend/migration.mo: Motoko migration module that transforms the old comment storage format (Map of post ID to List of comments) into a new flat Map of comment ID to enriched NewComment records with additional fields like likes, parentCommentId, and isDeleted.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report JSON mapping feature IDs to their titles, associated files, component dependencies, and test IDs for the comment system (React Query hooks, CommentSection component, PostCard integration) and other platform features.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: A JSON-formatted text file containing one-sentence summaries of all frontend source files, describing the purpose and key implementation details of each component, page, hook, and style file in the project.
frontend/ANDROID_BRANDING_ASSETS.md: Documents the Android branding asset files (app icon, adaptive icon foreground/background, splash screen) stored in frontend/public/assets/generated/ and explains how they are used to generate Android native resources for the Capacitor build.
frontend/ANDROID_PLAY_STORE_BUILD.md: Step-by-step guide for building a production Android App Bundle (AAB) for Google Play Store submission, covering prerequisites like signing key creation and Android Studio setup.
frontend/android/.gitignore: Git ignore rules for the Android project directory, excluding IDE files, build outputs, keystore/signing files, NDK artifacts, and Capacitor config.
frontend/android/keystore/README.md: Documentation-only README explaining what an Android keystore is and how to create one using keytool, with a warning not to store actual keystore files in this directory.
frontend/capacitor.config.ts: Capacitor configuration for the CivWorld Android app, setting the app ID, web directory, allowed navigation URLs for ICP/Internet Identity, and splash screen plugin settings.
frontend/index.css: Root Tailwind CSS file defining OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the light and dark color themes including background, foreground, primary, chart, and sidebar tokens.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the CivWorld frontend, setting viewport meta tags for mobile/Capacitor compatibility and mounting the React app via the /src/main.tsx module script.
frontend/scripts/android-build.sh: Bash script that automates the CivWorld Android build process by sequentially building the web app, syncing to Android via Capacitor, and running Gradle for either debug APK or release AAB output.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main React application entry point that defines the TanStack Router route tree, QueryClient provider, theme provider, and the AppLayout shell (Header, BottomNav, ProfileSetupModal) wrapping all page routes.
Installs a shim that intercepts `window.open` calls in the Capacitor WebView, redirecting Internet Identity authentication URLs to the Capacitor Browser plugin for proper native handling.
frontend/src/capacitor/README.md: Documentation listing prerequisites and initial setup steps for building CivWorld as an Android app using Capacitor, including required SDK versions and tooling.
frontend/src/capacitor/runtime.ts: Provides platform detection utility functions (isCapacitor, getPlatform, isAndroid, isIOS) that safely check the Capacitor runtime environment on the window object.
frontend/src/capacitor/TROUBLESHOOTING_I: Troubleshooting guide for diagnosing Internet Identity authentication issues in the CivWorld Android app, covering symptoms and diagnosis for common problems like a non-responsive login button.
frontend/src/components/AnalyticsDashboa: React component that displays a user analytics dashboard with stat cards for posts, likes, poll votes, and followers, plus sections for trending hashtags, top posts, and top contributors.
frontend/src/components/BadgeDisplay.tsx: React component that renders a row of civic badge icons with tooltips, supporting configurable size and a maximum display count with an overflow indicator.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Fixed bottom navigation bar with five items (Home, Reels, Discuss, Polls, Communities) that highlights the active route and navigates using TanStack Router.
frontend/src/components/BuildInfoIndicat: Small UI component that displays the current build ID retrieved from a utility function, shown as a labeled code indicator.
frontend/src/components/ChatWindow.tsx: Renders a chat window UI for messaging between two users, displaying message history and a send input; messaging functionality is stubbed as 'coming soon'.
frontend/src/components/CommentSection.t: Displays a threaded comment section for a post with support for adding, editing, deleting, liking, and replying to comments using backend query hooks.
frontend/src/components/CreateDiscussion: Modal dialog for creating a new discussion with fields for category, title, context, and region; submits via the useCreateDiscussion hook.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupModal: Modal form for creating a new group with name, description, and optional cover image upload with progress tracking via the useCreateGroup hook.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupPageM: Simple modal that lets users choose between navigating to create a group or create a page, routing accordingly.
frontend/src/components/CreateGroupPostM: Modal for composing and submitting a new post (text and/or image) within a specific group, with image preview and upload progress support.
frontend/src/components/CreatePollCard.t: Component for creating a poll card; content was truncated so full details are unavailable.
frontend/src/components/CreatePostCard.t: A card component that allows authenticated users to create posts with optional image or video attachments, uploading media as ExternalBlobs and submitting via the useCreatePost mutation.
frontend/src/components/CVTBalanceCard.t: Card component displaying a user's CVT token balance with a gradient background and disabled buttons for transaction history and CVT transfer actions.
frontend/src/components/DashboardCards.t: Displays two dashboard summary cards showing the user's Civic Token balance and verification status, fetched from their profile.
frontend/src/components/EditConstituency: A modal dialog that lets users update their constituency/location using a hierarchical location selector, saving the result to their profile.
frontend/src/components/EditPostModal.ts: A modal dialog for editing an existing post's text and media, supporting image/video replacement and uploading via ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/components/EditProfileModal: A modal form for editing the user's profile name, bio, and location using a hierarchical location selector, saving changes via the saveProfile mutation.
frontend/src/components/EditProfilePictu: A modal dialog for uploading, previewing, or removing the user's profile photo, processing the image before saving it as an ExternalBlob.
frontend/src/components/GroupsPagesFAB.t: An empty file with no content, likely a placeholder for a floating action button component on the Groups page.
frontend/src/components/Header.tsx: Sticky app header with greeting, App/Wallet toggle navigation, and login/logout button using Internet Identity authentication.
frontend/src/components/HierarchicalLoca: Multi-level location selector (country → state → district → MP/MLA constituency) with searchable dropdowns that load options via location query hooks.
frontend/src/components/PartnershipBanne: Simple decorative banner card promoting a civic community partnership program with a gradient background and sparkle icon.
frontend/src/components/PostCard.tsx: Displays a single social post with like/unlike (optimistic updates), delete, share, and comment toggle functionality, supporting text, image, and video content.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetupModa: Modal dialog for new users to create their profile by entering name, bio, and location using the hierarchical location selector.
Gradient promotional card encouraging users to explore civic communities, with a navigation button linking to the communities route.
frontend/src/components/QuickPostBar.tsx: Inline post creation bar that opens a dialog for composing text posts with optional image or video attachments, including upload progress tracking.
frontend/src/components/ReportModal.tsx: A modal dialog component that allows users to report posts, comments, or profiles by selecting a reason (spam, misinformation, etc.) and optionally adding details, then submitting via the useSubmitReport hook.
Displays a horizontally scrollable list of trending hashtags fetched via useGetTrendingHashtags, supporting selection highlighting and navigation to topic pages or a custom click handler.
frontend/src/components/VerificationStat: A card component that shows whether a user's account is verified or not, with styled indicators and a disabled action button for viewing details or initiating verification.
frontend/src/components/VerifiedBadge.ts: A small icon component that renders a checkmark badge with a tooltip indicating a verified account, supporting three size variants.
frontend/src/components/WalletView.tsx: Displays the user's Civic Token balance, disabled send/receive action buttons, a coming-soon notice, and an empty recent activity section fetched from the caller's profile.
frontend/src/context/ViewContext.tsx: Provides a React context for toggling between 'app' and 'wallet' views, exposing the current view state and a setter via the useView hook.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: A hook that creates and caches an authenticated or anonymous backend actor using React Query, invalidating and refetching dependent queries whenever the actor changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Implements an Internet Identity authentication context and provider using @dfinity/auth-client, exposing login/logout functions, identity state, and login status to child components.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocationQueries.ts: Provides React Query hooks for fetching hierarchical location data (countries, states, districts, MP/MLA constituencies, mandals, villages) from the backend actor, with appropriate caching and enabled conditions.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Central collection of React Query hooks and mutations for all major backend operations including user profiles, posts, comments, polls, groups, and pages, along with shared TypeScript types like AnalyticsResult and TrendingHashtagItem.
frontend/src/index.css: Global stylesheet that imports fonts, sets up Tailwind directives, and defines OKLCH-based CSS custom properties for the design system including brand colors (saffron, deep-blue), light/dark theme tokens, and utility classes.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that mounts the React app with QueryClientProvider and InternetIdentityProvider wrappers around the root App component.
frontend/src/pages/CommunitiesPage.tsx: Page component that displays a tabbed list of Groups and Pages fetched from the backend, with card components for each item and navigation to their detail pages.
frontend/src/pages/CreateGroupPage.tsx: Form page for creating a new group, allowing the user to input a name, description, and optional cover image, then submitting via the useCreateGroup mutation.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePagePage.tsx: A form page for creating a new community page, allowing users to input a name, category, description, privacy setting, and optional profile image, then submitting via the useCreatePage mutation.
frontend/src/pages/CreatePollPage.tsx: A form page for creating a poll with a question, 2–6 options, and a public/private toggle, submitting via the useCreatePoll mutation and navigating to /polls on success.
frontend/src/pages/DiscussionsPage.tsx: Displays a feed of discussion posts fetched via useGetPosts, with a CreatePostCard for authenticated users and loading/empty states.
frontend/src/pages/EducationPage.tsx: A civic education page with tabs for learning modules and quizzes, using static sample data and a detail view for individual modules.
frontend/src/pages/EventsPage.tsx: A placeholder Events & Campaigns page displaying a 'Coming Soon' card that outlines planned features like event creation, RSVP, location-based discovery, and reminders.
frontend/src/pages/ExplorePage.tsx: An explore page with three tabs—Trending (top liked posts), Groups (list of all groups with navigation), and Analytics—fetching data via useGetPosts and useGetGroups.
frontend/src/pages/GroupDetailPage.tsx: Displays a single group's detail page with cover image, member count, join/leave actions, and a list of group posts. Authenticated users can join/leave the group and create new posts via a modal.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsAndPagesPage.ts: Shows a tabbed view listing all groups and pages, allowing authenticated users to navigate to individual group or page details or create new ones.
frontend/src/pages/GroupsPage.tsx: Lists all available groups with cover images and descriptions, letting authenticated users navigate to a group detail page or create a new group.
frontend/src/pages/HomePage.tsx: Renders the main feed with promotional banners, trending section, a constituency shortcut, and a paginated list of posts; supports a wallet view toggle and quick post creation for authenticated users.
frontend/src/pages/MessagesPage.tsx: Provides a direct-messaging UI where users enter a Principal ID to start a conversation, then renders a ChatWindow component for that user.
frontend/src/pages/MyAreaPage.tsx: Allows authenticated users to report and view local community issues with title, description, location, and a status indicator (new, in review, resolved), stored in local component state.
frontend/src/pages/MyConstituencyPage.ts: Displays the user's constituency information (country, state, district, MP/MLA constituencies) parsed from their profile location, with an edit button that opens an EditConstituencyModal.
frontend/src/pages/PageDetailPage.tsx: Shows detailed information for a single Page fetched by ID, including profile image, name, category, description, owner, and creation date, with a back button to communities.
frontend/src/pages/PagesPage.tsx: Lists all community pages with their image and category, and provides a button to navigate to the create-page route.
frontend/src/pages/PollsPage.tsx: Renders a list of polls where authenticated users can vote on options; each PollCard shows vote percentages after voting and prevents duplicate votes.
frontend/src/pages/ProfilePage.tsx: Displays the current user's profile (photo, bio, location, stats) with tabs for their posts and an analytics dashboard, plus modals for editing profile info and profile picture.
frontend/src/pages/ReelPage.tsx: Placeholder page indicating that short-form video Reels functionality is coming soon.
frontend/src/pages/SharePage.tsx: Content creation page that renders a CreatePostCard and placeholder cards for event creation and video upload (both marked as coming soon), navigating home after a post is created.
frontend/src/pages/TopicPage.tsx: Displays a filtered list of posts matching a given hashtag topic, fetched from all posts, with a sticky header showing the topic name and post count.
frontend/src/pages/UserProfilePage.tsx: Shows a user's profile page including their avatar, bio, follow/unfollow controls, post list, and a report modal, using the user's principal ID from route params.
frontend/src/pages/VideoPage.tsx: Placeholder page for a video feed feature that displays a 'coming soon' message with an icon.
frontend/src/pages/VideoReelsPage.tsx: TikTok-style vertical scrolling reels page using mock video data, with like, comment, and share action buttons overlaid on each reel.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPage.tsx: Displays the authenticated user's wallet page including CVT token balance, CivPoints summary card, and navigation to detailed wallet views; shows a login prompt if unauthenticated.
frontend/src/pages/WalletPointsPage.tsx: Shows the user's CivPoints wallet with current balance, daily/total earned stats, level info, and a scrollable transaction history with labeled action types.
frontend/src/types/index.ts: Defines all shared TypeScript interfaces and enums for the frontend, including types for users, posts, polls, wallets, groups, notifications, local issues, and discussions.
frontend/src/utils/backendErrors.ts: Provides centralized error handling utilities that convert IC canister/agent errors and other error types into user-friendly English messages, with an alias `formatBackendError` for backward compatibility.
frontend/src/utils/buildId.ts: Derives a runtime build identifier by extracting a hash from loaded script URLs, falling back to a timestamp-based ID if no hashed filename is found.
frontend/src/utils/candidOption.ts: Provides utilities for normalizing and validating Candid optional `MediaContent` fields (text, image, video) before backend submission, ensuring null instead of undefined for proper serialization.
frontend/src/utils/profilePhotoValidatio: Validates profile photo files for type (JPG/PNG) and size (≤5MB), and processes them by center-cropping to a square, scaling to 800px, and compressing to JPEG via canvas.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for reading URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, persisting them to sessionStorage, and cleaning sensitive parameters from the URL bar.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration for the frontend, defining custom colors (saffron, deep-blue, semantic tokens via OKLCH CSS variables), fonts, breakpoints, border radii, shadows, and enabling typography, container-queries, and animate plugins.
frontend/WALLET_VISIBILITY_AUDIT.md: Audit checklist documenting that wallet UI (WalletPage, /wallet route, Header and BottomNav navigation entries) was missing before the current build and detailing all resolutions applied, including a runtime build ID utility for deployment verification.
project_state.json: Tracks the current state of the CivWorld social platform project, including architectural notes, known issues (broken comments, poll results, build size), and a registry of existing and planned features with their requirement IDs and versions.
